items.title: Designing governance-first AI agents with Fenergo using Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents are transforming financial services — but in regulated industries, capability alone doesn't drive adoption. Trust does. In this post, Fenergo and AWS engineers walk through the architecture behind the Fenergo Agent Operating System (Agent OS): a governance-first layer built on Amazon Bedrock, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon SNS, Amazon SQS, and Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB that makes every agent decision traceable, explainable, and audit-ready. Learn how to design agentic AI systems that answer the question regulators always ask: why?
items.creator: Richi Pandey
